title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
lede: More than 115,000 people, including Elon Musk and other tech CEOs, have signed a petition asking Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang while an independent investigation runs.

points: The petition site lists 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees and 63,063 shareholders among the signers.
Other named backers include Replit's Amjad Masad, Epic Games' Tim Sweeney and Y Combinator's Garry Tan.
It says Huang lacked due process and asks the board for a fair inquiry and more public disclosure.
Huang resigned Thursday after admitting an affair with a chip executive U.S. intelligence suspects of spying for China, and has agreed to testify to Congress.
CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while Nvidia searches for a permanent replacement.

sections.text: Nvidia's stock fell sharply through the week and Huang's exit is expected to leave a large hole in AI industry funding, so the leadership fight reaches well beyond one company.
